name: Emotion Bridge
description: Encoder translating PAD (Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance) emotional dimensions to 39-bit binary strings with causality-drill mechanisms. Captures FELT events — topological field shifts detected before producing emotion. Bridges the pre-cognitive energetic field with conscious emotional experience through geometric encoding of affective space.

core_attributes.pattern: PAD dimensional encoding, FELT event detection, pre-cognitive field sensing

scope.definition: Fraction of reported emotional states classifiable within the PAD (Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance) three-dimensional space — measured by variance explained in self-report emotion data by 3-factor PAD model.

evidence.source: Russell & Mehrabian (1977) 'Evidence for a three-component theory of emotion', Journal of Research in Personality 11:273-294; Watson & Tellegen (1985) 'Toward a consensual structure of mood', Psychological Bulletin 98:219-235.
cross_domain_examples: PAD model explains 82-92% of variance in semantic differential emotion ratings across 8 languages
Ekman 6 basic emotions map to distinct PAD regions with 0.87 classification accuracy
Russell (1980) circumplex model: 2-factor subset of PAD explains 75% of variance

scope.falsifiability: If a novel emotion report dataset shows PAD model explaining <50% of rating variance, the 3-dimensional space is insufficient for that cultural or linguistic context.
scope.measurement_limits: PAD coverage varies by culture and language — WEIRD (Western Educated Industrial Rich Democratic) samples show higher PAD coverage. Cross-cultural emotion concepts that lack PAD equivalents exist in many traditions.
